lanes.notes: Repo-authored public/loader/renderer/subpath type matrix. Not a pristine upstream type suite.

divergences.upstreamResult: R3F embeds React Reconciler for component execution and scheduling.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane owns execution, hooks, context, scheduling, Suspense, refs, and effects.
divergences.rationale: The binding targets Octane's universal renderer contract.
divergences.consumerImpact: React renderer internals are not exposed.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use Octane components and scheduling helpers.

divergences.upstreamResult: R3F roots render a React element descriptor.
divergences.octaneResult: Roots render an Octane component plus props.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Pass the component and props separately.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if root render signatures converge.

divergences.upstreamResult: React callable store selectors inherit React hook identity.
divergences.octaneResult: Dynamic callable selectors are order-based; compiler-visible hooks retain conditional identity.
divergences.rationale: Dynamic calls cannot receive compiler slots.
divergences.consumerImpact: Conditional dynamic selector call ordering must remain stable.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Prefer compiler-visible useStore and useThree calls.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if dynamic hook slot propagation is introduced.

divergences.upstreamResult: R3F can publish empty or undefined graph keys.
divergences.octaneResult: buildGraph omits unnamed and array-valued material entries.
divergences.rationale: Only stable named identities are useful graph keys.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Assign names to graph objects consumed by key.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream graph semantics change.

divergences.upstreamResult: R3F 9.6.1 writes the default to a root leaf key when removing a pierced prop.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane restores the original nested target.
divergences.rationale: The upstream behavior targets the wrong object.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not depend on the upstream misplaced root property.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream fixes pierced reset.

divergences.upstreamResult: R3F updates only outer capture and hover identities during reconstruction.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane also rewrites nested stored intersections to the replacement.
divergences.rationale: Captured delivery must not reference retired objects.
divergences.consumerImpact: Post-reconstruction captured events target the live object.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not retain retired intersection objects.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream rewrites nested intersections.

divergences.upstreamResult: R3F can raycast hidden retained descendants through visible ancestors.
divergences.octaneResult: Hidden Activity subtrees are excluded from recursive raycasts.
divergences.rationale: Three r172 raycasting does not honor Object3D.visible recursively.
divergences.consumerImpact: Hidden retained content cannot receive pointer hits.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not rely on interaction with hidden Activity descendants.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Three or upstream raycast visibility changes.

divergences.upstreamResult: R3F portal target lifetime is tied to reconciler ownership.
divergences.octaneResult: Target handles are root-scoped and cross-root placement is rejected before mutation.
divergences.rationale: Universal target ownership must be explicit.
divergences.consumerImpact: Cross-root portal placement throws without partial mutation.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Create portals within the target's owning root.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if universal portal ownership changes.

divergences.upstreamResult: R3F defers registry teardown and callback delivery by 500ms.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane teardown and callback delivery are synchronous.
divergences.consumerImpact: Resources and callbacks settle before unmount returns.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not add a delay when awaiting teardown.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream removes delayed teardown.

divergences.upstreamResult: R3F has no equivalent explicit-target low-level DOMRegion primitive.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane exposes DOMRegion without positioning, occlusion, styling, or layout semantics.
divergences.rationale: It proves the universal Three-to-DOM boundary without claiming Drei Html parity.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers own all layout and styling.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Treat DOMRegion as an explicit target boundary, not Drei Html.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if a higher-level HTML overlay API is added.
